title: Târgoviște, Dâmbovița — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Târgoviște, Dâmbovița: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Târgoviște is a city in Dâmbovița with a population of 79,610. The former capital of Wallachia, known for the Chindia Tower, the Royal Court ruins, and its role in the history of Vlad the Impaler. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
